files.sources/scanner-notes.md:
# Scan station notes

The station saves scans to a USB drive and does not send them by email. The user chooses PDF or JPEG before pressing Scan. PDF puts all pages in one file; JPEG saves each page as a separate file. Eject is available after saving finishes. Removing the drive while saving can leave an incomplete file. Staff at the desk can help.
files.docs/scan-handout.md:
# Save a scan to your USB drive

Insert your USB drive, then choose PDF or JPEG. PDF saves all pages in one file. JPEG saves each page as a separate file. Place your pages on the scanner and press Scan.

Wait until saving finishes, then choose Eject before removing your drive. Removing it while saving can leave an incomplete file. The station cannot email scans. Ask at the desk if you need help.
